decisions.reason: The coolant cleaning centrifuge strengthens the firm's filtration and sustainability offer and complements its coolant management systems, so withdrawing it would weaken a coherent portfolio.
The coolant nozzle line is a low-cost accessory range that supports cross-selling with pumps and filtration systems, though it is somewhat exposed after the booster system was withdrawn.
Scraper belt chip conveyors are a staple of the firm's core conveying business for metalworking customers.
Magnetic belt chip conveyors fill an established niche in the chip conveyor portfolio and meet standard customer needs.
Hinged belt chip conveyors are among the most widely used conveyor types and central to the firm's established offer.
